column1: # Single source for rust/crates/py/src/command.rs pins() and tests/test_command.py TestCommandPrefixes.
# Both consumers parse this file directly; there is no inline copy of these rows.
#   command  — the raw command line. Escape scheme: backslash -> \\, newline -> \n.
#              Decode by scanning for '\': '\n' -> newline, '\\' -> backslash.
#   expected — the expected prefix tuple, prefixes joined by '|' (U+007C, verified
#              absent from every prefix value here). An empty field is the empty tuple.
